positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend Engineer on the Word Web Platform team. Previously a Full Stack Engineer on the Bing Ads team.

company.name: Cockrell School of Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Senior Student Associate
positions.description: The Cockrell School Development team is in charge of gathering donations and endowments for the Engineering School at The University of Texas at Austin.  As a student associate, I perform various tasks to help our gift officers and associate deans, such as strategizing and executing donor cultivation to secure more endowments, updating donor information, and preparing for large events conducted by the Cockrell School

positions.title: Student Manager
positions.description: Friends of Alec is an alumni outreach program with the Cockrell School of Engineering at University of Texas at Austin that works to raise donations to support and fund the Engineering college's 7 academic departments, scholarships, and student organizations. Along with calling alumni twice a week, I manage 14 student callers one night a week. My responsibilities include making sure everyone is on task, no technical difficulties arise, organize paperwork, and encourage students to work above and beyond their goals. In total, I have raised over $20,000 for the Cockrell School of Engineering.

positions.title: Student Caller
positions.description: Friends of Alec is an alumni outreach program with the Cockrell School of Engineering at University of Texas at Austin that works to raise donations to support and fund the Engineering college's 7 academic departments, scholarships, and student organizations. I worked for 2 nights a week for 9 months. In this job, I called alumni, engaged in conversation with them, and in the end persuaded them to make a donation to the Friends of Alec. After 9 months, I was able to raise over $11,500 for the Cockrell School of Engineering at UT.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Google is a leading corporation of internet services ranging from search, maps, and much more. I was a part of the Search APIs team within the Google Web Server platform in Google Search. During my internship, I built and expanded an internal tool meant for our clients that allowed for immediate information on how a particular query was processed by an API. In addition, I worked with Java, html, bash, C++, and protocol buffers as well as participated in weekly, bi-weekly, and quarterly team meetings.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
HERE is a mapping corporation that works to provide several services and technologies to consumers and automotive companies. I worked in the Automotive section of the company, in the Humanized Driving team in Automotive Cloud Services.
In my internship, I
• Reimplemented and optimized Hadoop MapReduce jobs.
• Reduced execution time by 60% for an existing MapReduce job. 
• Worked with Java, Maven, Amazon Web Services, and Git.
• Participated in daily stand-up and bi-weekly sprint planning and retrospectives.

positions.title: Library Page
positions.description: I worked at my local library for one and half years. My responsibilities were to organize and sort books, as well as to make sure the library always looked presentable and clean.
